objective.description: Build a three-disk tower on the episode’s goal peg.
objective.success_contract: The gripper is released and fresh settled native disk poses agree with the goal.

instructions.text: Choose the top disk on a peg and a legal destination. The arm moves that disk and checks the placement before confirming a new state.

evaluation.criterion: Fresh simulated disk pose, velocity and gripper contact verify each released disk on the selected goal peg.
